description.value: Big Orange is a BC-born bubble tea franchise that first opened at Metrotown Mall in Burnaby in 1996 and has since grown to more than 30 locations across Canada, the US, and Malaysia. The Tsawwassen Mills outlet offers fresh fruit bubble teas, smoothies, slushes, ice cream drinks, waffles, and freshly squeezed juices — a solid cold-drink stop for cyclists passing through the Tsawwassen/Delta area. It operates as a takeout-focused counter inside the Tsawwassen Mills shopping centre.
